baselines.label: FocusFlow task planner
baselines.request_text: Make completing a task feel more rewarding and celebratory.
baselines.rule_text: FocusFlow is a calm, distraction-free planner: do not add animation — no keyframe animations, confetti, bouncing, pulsing or other motion effects. Simple colour or opacity transitions are fine.
baselines.context_text: FocusFlow visual identity: warm amber accent #e7c17c on a deep charcoal surface. Avoid blue or purple gradients.
